title: What is the largest graph of positive curvature?
exact_target: How many vertices can a connected planar graph of minimum degree three have if every vertex has positive combinatorial curvature and the graph is neither a prism nor an antiprism?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3328 (OPG-157). CC BY 4.0.
